description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmailTemplatesViewClassic' class which extends 'ViewClassic'. Its purpose is to override the default meta-data DetailView behavior for email templates in the SuiteCRM system, primarily toggling the display of subpanels during the DetailView action.

classes.description: A class that customizes the DetailView behavior for email templates in SuiteCRM.
